pages.title: Ball Sort
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Sort colored balls into tubes in Ball Sort. Move one top ball at a time and use empty tubes as temporary space until every tube holds a single color.

pages.title: Chroma Tower
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Take a tower apart from above in Chroma Tower. Drop a block into a column to erase a connected group of its color. Use the resulting cascades before your moves run out.

pages.title: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Sort tangled threads by color in Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle. Work through trickier arrangements and use tools such as the Magic Box or New Hole when you need more room.

pages.title: Color Sort: Impostor Edition
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Group the little characters by color in Color Sort: Impostor Edition. Move them between tubes and keep track of spare space when new colors make the puzzle harder.

pages.title: Hill Racing - Egg drop!
pages.creator: PHATCAT Games Ltd
pages.description: Carry an egg over hills in Hill Racing - Egg drop! Hold to accelerate and release to slow down. Keep the egg aboard and collect coins to upgrade cars and levels.

pages.title: Relay Race
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Get your runner to the finish in Relay Race. Work out the trick behind each obstacle and solve the puzzles that interrupt the race as the challenges change.

pages.title: K-Pop Hunter Halloween Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Create a spooky stage look in K-Pop Hunter Halloween Fashion. Mix Halloween costumes with new hairstyles and accessories, then see how each outfit comes together on the performer.

pages.title: Crazy Screw King
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Remove screws into bins of the same color in Crazy Screw King. Watch the glass shift as you release its fasteners, then collect the remaining screws in their matching crates.

pages.title: Mickey Run Adventure Game
pages.creator: Todos For Games
pages.description: Race through the kingdom in Mickey Run Adventure Game. Jump and dash past mice and other obstacles as you collect coins, and try to keep the run going.

pages.title: Potion Merge Witch
pages.creator: Briuor
pages.description: Bring identical bottles together in Potion Merge Witch. Make bigger potions, or use one of the special buttons to shake the cauldron, remove a bottle, or upgrade a potion.

pages.title: Cleaning Princess
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Choose from five timed activities in Cleaning Princess. Use the right tools for teeth, ears, heels, a back spa, or even a dusty fan before the countdown ends.

pages.title: Colors&Forms
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Handle falling shapes and changing palettes in Colors&Forms. Complete the level missions and build up your piece count to unlock Infinity, where you can keep collecting for a higher score.

pages.title: Monster Makeup 3D
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Disguise monsters as humans in Monster Makeup 3D. Choose skin color, eye lenses, teeth, and a wig, checking that the finished look can pass without drawing the crowd's attention.

pages.title: Mermaid Wedding World
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Prepare an undersea royal wedding in Mermaid Wedding World. Dress the couple and their guests, then decorate the room, set the table, and help serve the food.

pages.title: RobyBox - Space Station Warehouse
pages.creator: AlexCG
pages.description: Move crates into place to open doors in RobyBox - Space Station Warehouse. Watch for pursuing bots and use drills, mines, or the station's own traps to stop them.

pages.title: The Trendy Mermaid
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Give Ariel a new look in The Trendy Mermaid. Use the mouse to try clothes, makeup, and accessories, then put the pieces together for her comeback.

pages.title: Drive Car Parking Simulation Game
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Drive to a highlighted bay in Drive Car Parking Simulation Game. Watch the clock as you steer a luxury car through narrow streets and make the final turn without crashing.

pages.title: Crazy Racing
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Overtake traffic in Crazy Racing and blow up cars blocking your way. Look for an opening to pass and react quickly when another vehicle moves into your path.

pages.title: Racer Car Smash
pages.creator: Dev Hub Games
pages.description: Send a small car into the target hole in Racer Car Smash. Set the direction before each shot and plan a line that takes the car past the obstacles.

pages.title: Car Makeup
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Match the reference car in Car Makeup. Tap to choose the same parts as the example, then compare your score with your rival's once the level is judged.

pages.title: Ball Drop Blitz
pages.creator: Orosula Games
pages.description: Draw a route for the balls in Ball Drop Blitz. Steer them around obstacles and leave a clear path to the finish. Enough balls must make it through to win.

pages.title: Gas Station Arcade
pages.creator: Lipsar Studio LLC
pages.description: Rebuild and run a service station in Gas Station Arcade. Put profits into the store and pumps, and hire workers when the growing queue becomes too much to handle alone.

pages.title: Hats Mahjong Connect
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Link matching hats in Hats Mahjong Connect. The route between a pair can turn only twice, so clear the tiles that give you better access before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Squid Fall Guy
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Guide a character down from the island in Squid Fall Guy. Use the descent control to work past obstacles, and check what lies below before trying to land.

pages.title: Jiraikei Aesthetics
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create a Jiraikei-inspired outfit in Jiraikei Aesthetics. Combine black and pink clothing and try makeup that emphasizes the eyes, then see how the styling choices look together.

pages.title: Sword Master 3D
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Swipe your blade through projectiles and barrels in Sword Master 3D. Use slowed time to cut through flying bullets and send oversized throwing stars back at the stickmen.

pages.title: Fall Friends
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Push through a crowded obstacle course in Fall Friends. Watch your footing as runners collide and jostle for space, and reach the finish before you're eliminated.

pages.title: Words With Buddies
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Spell English words against other players in Words With Buddies. Drag letter tiles into place and look for score bonuses that multiply a letter or the whole word.

pages.title: PopStar Mania
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Tap groups of adjacent matching blocks in PopStar Mania. Larger pops help you reach the target score for each stage. Take time to plan, since there's no countdown.

pages.title: Knife Shooting
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Throw knives at targets in Knife Shooting. Time each throw to hit its mark, work through the levels, and collect apples to spend on new knives.

pages.title: Santa Claus Christmas Preparation
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Get Santa ready to travel in Santa Claus Christmas Preparation. Groom the reindeer, spruce up the sleigh, choose Santa's outfit, and make ice dolls to give as presents.

pages.title: Draw Bullet Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Draw a bullet's route across a rooftop in Draw Bullet Master. Plan a path through the attackers while keeping the hostage safe, and try to finish before the enemies return fire.

pages.title: Hydro Storm 2
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description: Race armed jet skis in Hydro Storm 2. Steer through the course with WASD or the arrows and use your primary and secondary weapons when rivals get in range.

pages.title: Go Go Panda
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: Collect coins in Go Go Panda while avoiding arrows and obstacles. Jump or double-jump over hazards and roll through caves, then see how far you made it before trying again.

pages.title: Army Sniper
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pick off opponents with a rifle in Army Sniper. Tap to shoot and line up each target before firing as you work through the game's two-dimensional encounters.

pages.title: Shadow Fights
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Trade punches and kicks in Shadow Fights. Play three rounds against the computer or share the keyboard with a friend, and look for an opening after you dodge a blow.

pages.title: Rally Point 2
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description: Beat target times in Rally Point 2 to unlock cars and tracks. Drift through corners and use nitro when the route opens up, but ease off before the engine overheats.

pages.title: Zombie Smack
pages.creator: Dumadu Games Pvt Ltd
pages.description: Smash the approaching undead in Zombie Smack. Watch the incoming crowd and take out the closest zombies first to give yourself room to survive the rest of the attack.

pages.title: Two Ball 3D Dark
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Roll through dark courses in Two Ball 3D Dark. Look ahead for traps, use the wings to steady jumps off ramps, and collect diamonds for different ball skins.

pages.title: Happy Easter Links
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Connect matching Easter tiles in Happy Easter Links. A path can make no more than two turns, and some boards slide as pairs disappear. Clear the layout before time runs out.

pages.title: Crossword Puzzles AWS-PROD
pages.creator: Genius Games
pages.description: Choose an across or down clue in Crossword Puzzles AWS-PROD and fill the highlighted squares with its answer. Use crossing letters to check your guesses, then request another completed-grid challenge.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Laundry Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Learn to wash clothes with Baby Hazel in Baby Hazel Laundry Time. Help her sort whites from colors, use the washing machine, and work through drying and ironing.

pages.title: Fall Race Season 2
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Race across changing platforms in Fall Race Season 2. Move with WASD or the arrows and press space to jump. Time the gaps to reach the finish without falling.

pages.title: Snake Puzzle
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Untangle a route out for the trapped snakes in Snake Puzzle. Drag each one through the available space and look ahead for dead ends before moving another.

pages.title: Wheelie Biker
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Lift the front wheel in Wheelie Biker and keep it up to fill the meter. Balance the bike until you reach the finish, and unlock new bikes as you progress.

pages.title: Christmas Cars Find the Bells
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Find ten bells per picture in Christmas Cars Find the Bells. Search the holiday vehicles and backgrounds before the timer expires. Repeated wrong guesses take five seconds off the clock.

pages.title: Find the Differences
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Compare two pictures in Find the Differences and pick out the details that change. Check their outlines and backgrounds for alterations that are easy to miss at first glance.

pages.title: What the objects
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Put each item where it belongs in What the objects. Look at the object and the places available for it, then choose the spot that corresponds to it.

pages.title: Police Auto Rickshaw Game 2020
pages.creator: gamefun
pages.description: Patrol the city in Police Auto Rickshaw Game 2020. Drive a police tuk-tuk through the streets and use it to pursue bank robbers and other suspects.

pages.title: Math Bug
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Solve the problem on screen in Math Bug and click the correct result. Compare the possible answers with your calculation before choosing one, then move on to the next problem.

pages.title: Bouncy Dunks
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Slide the paddle under the ball in Bouncy Dunks and bounce it through a hoop. Collect stars for five extra points each and keep the ball from dropping past the paddle.

pages.title: Strike Bowling King 3D Bowling Game
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Roll for strikes and spares in Strike Bowling King 3D Bowling Game. Adjust where the ball meets the pins and try using a hook to change the approach to the pocket.

pages.title: BFF Summer Fashion
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Give Mia and Bella fresh looks in BFF Summer Fashion. Use the mouse to choose summer outfits for both friends, then find makeup that works with each set of clothes.

pages.title: Pop The Bug
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Pop insects before the timer expires in Pop The Bug. Some arrive inside bubbles, so break the bubble before popping the insect. Keep up as the bugs become harder to catch.

pages.title: Impossible Truck Tracks Drive
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Drive a truck through high stunt courses in Impossible Truck Tracks Drive. Steer through the tight sections and give yourself time to line up each approach as you work through the missions.

pages.title: Toys Mahjong Connect
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pair identical toy tiles in Toys Mahjong Connect. The path between the tiles can have up to two bends. Clear all the pairs, and finish quickly for a time bonus.

pages.title: Jet Racer Infinite Flight Rider Space Racing
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Pilot a jet through traffic in Jet Racer Infinite Flight Rider Space Racing. Dodge other aircraft and stay clear of their paths to see how long you can keep flying.

pages.title: Lemo Car Game
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description: Take a limousine through the car wash in Lemo Car Game. Work through the vehicle-cleaning tasks and handle the long car carefully as you move through the service area.

pages.title: Real City Coach Bus Simulator
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Drive a coach through city streets in Real City Coach Bus Simulator. Try the available camera views to judge the bus's position, especially when approaching tight turns.

pages.title: SUV Classic Car Parking Real Driving
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Take on parking layouts in SUV Classic Car Parking Real Driving. Slow down on the approach and use the available space to get the vehicle straight before parking it.

pages.title: Impossible Stunt Car Tracks Game 3D
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description: Drive a car along high stunt tracks in Impossible Stunt Car Tracks Game 3D. Line up for the sharp turns and watch the edges as you steer through the course.

pages.title: Cryptic Quotes
pages.creator: DoxxaSoft
pages.description: Decode a famous quotation in Cryptic Quotes. Substitute letters for the symbols and look for repeated patterns. As words become readable, use them to narrow down the remaining letters.

pages.title: Caribbean Stud Poker
pages.creator: Joypad Media
pages.description: Play a hand against the dealer in Caribbean Stud Poker. Place a wager with the game's chips, then see whether the poker hand you're dealt can beat the house.

pages.title: Free Vbucks Spin Wheel in Fortnite
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Watch where the pointer lands in Free Vbucks Spin Wheel in Fortnite. Start a spin, let the wheel come to rest, and read the result shown on the segment.

pages.title: Sliding Emoji
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Use the mouse to guide an emoji toward gold in Sliding Emoji. Keep collecting the pieces you can reach and try to raise your score with each run.

pages.title: Ball And Target
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Aim the ball at the target in Ball And Target. Line up your shot before firing. The game speeds up as you continue, and sending the ball out ends the attempt.

pages.title: Prom Queen Dress Up High School
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Plan graduation-party outfits in Prom Queen Dress Up High School. Try different dresses and hairstyles on the students, then decide what suits each one for the end-of-school celebration.

pages.title: Pixel Gun Apocalypse 2
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Return to block-built combat in Pixel Gun Apocalypse 2. Move with WASD or the arrows, scope in with the right mouse button, and change weapons with the number keys.

pages.title: Air Combat Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore aviation pictures in Air Combat Slide. Choose from three images and three puzzle modes, then slide tiles to line up details such as the aircraft and sky.

pages.title: Jeep Ride
pages.creator: Darko Veljovic
pages.description: Take a jeep through twenty courses in Jeep Ride. Use the keyboard to drive over the obstacles and judge your approach as you work toward each finish.

pages.title: Mission to Mars Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Color eight space illustrations in Mission to Mars Coloring. Choose from 23 shades and work quickly if you want a higher score. Save your picture when you're finished.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Tomato Farming
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel grow tomatoes in Baby Hazel Tomato Farming. Prepare the seeds, pick out the tools and supplies, and follow the stages of planting in her kitchen garden.

pages.title: SamUP Online
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Help a jester get out of a deep hole in SamUP Online. Jump between the walls and grab gold as you climb. Use the mouse or touchscreen to control his movement.

pages.title: Escape Link
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Steer with WASD in Escape Link and watch for enemies closing in. Keep moving to make room for the next turn and try to stay alive long enough to beat your previous score.

pages.title: Princess Wedding Dress Up
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Shop for a bridal look in Princess Wedding Dress Up. Use the mouse to try different dresses and pair them with accessories before deciding what the bride will wear.

pages.title: Pro Bowling 3D
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Set your starting position and flick the ball in Pro Bowling 3D. Trace a curve when you want the ball to bend and see how many strikes you can accumulate.

pages.title: Adam and Eve 5 Part 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help Adam reach his true love in Adam and Eve 5 Part 2. Click or tap the objects in each scene and work out what makes the path forward open.

pages.title: Birds Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a bird illustration in Birds Coloring Book. Pick colors with the brush and fill the drawing, using different shades for the feathers, the background, or any details you want to highlight.

pages.title: Push the Mouse
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Guide every mouse to its destination in Push the Mouse. Tap the one you want to move and plan around its single direction of travel before sending another across its path.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Rush
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Line up Thanksgiving icons in groups of three or more in Thanksgiving Rush. Bigger matches score more, so work toward the point goal before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Puppet Killer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Try different weapons against a puppet in Puppet Killer. Switch between knives, guns, launchers, and flamethrowers to see how each one affects the target.

pages.title: Horace and Cheese
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Pull back and launch a hamster in Horace and Cheese. Collect the cheese for stars and aim for a safe landing in the cheese house. Avoid the blue pieces.

pages.title: Skater Kid
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Skate through town in Skater Kid. Watch for obstacles as you ride and time your moves to get past them, keeping the board going along the street.

pages.title: Jump Box Ninja
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Tap to send the ninja box upward in Jump Box Ninja. Time each jump to pass the spiky ledges and see how long you can climb without hitting one.

pages.title: Twitchie Clicker
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Build an audience from scratch in Twitchie Clicker. Click for views and cash, then upgrade your channel to earn views faster. Unlock videos as your subscriber base grows.

pages.title: Hurdle Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Clear as many hurdles as possible in Hurdle Rush. Move with the arrow keys and jump with space, or use the touch controls to time each leap.

pages.title: Princess Face Mix
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Combine facial features from different characters in Princess Face Mix. Start with the character you're given and use Face Mix to see how a different set of features changes the result.

pages.title: Dream Careers for Princesses
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Dress three princesses for the jobs they want in Dream Careers for Princesses. Style Rapunzel as a designer, Ariel as a model, and Cinderella as a pastry chef.

pages.title: Snake and Ladders
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Roll and move across a hundred squares in Snake and Ladders. Ladders send you upward while snakes send you back. Try the alternate board with chutes and babies if you want a different design.

pages.title: Nine Mens Morris
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Form lines of three in Nine Mens Morris. Place and move your pieces with the mouse and try to reduce your rival to two pieces or block every legal move.

pages.title: Ninja Ranmaru
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Run and fight through Ninja Ranmaru. Choose between attacking and defending when enemies meet you, then watch for the next obstacle as the run continues.

pages.title: Ice Queen Toddler Feed
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Prepare breakfast in Ice Queen Toddler Feed. Warm the milk, mix it with cereal, and feed the little one. Use toys and kisses to keep her happy while you work.

pages.title: Candy Fairy
pages.creator: Longames TEC Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Fly through a world made of candy in Candy Fairy. Steer past blocks and collect every crystal in the level to continue your attempt to save the castle.

pages.title: Sery Haute Couture Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Open wardrobe boxes to style Sery in Sery Haute Couture Dolly Dress Up H5. Pair dresses and accessories, aim for a five-star score, and see your looks in the gallery.
